releaseName: Lokify v1.4.1 – Human-Crafted Mobile UI, Small Toggles & 1-Click Google Sign-In
releaseNotes:
• Human-Crafted UI: Refined modern dark theme with clean sans-serif typography, elegant spacing, and removal of robotic monospace font overuse.
• Sleek Small Toggles: All toggle switches (segmented view controls, filter tabs, officer switches, GIS floating controls, and category chips) are now compact, small, and sleek.
• 1-Click Google Sign-In: Prominent one-tap Google tab button for seamless instant citizen sign-in with full profile persistence.
